name: Coda clone design repository
versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs between tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json and this manifest. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers: nothing checks them automatically, so they imply no enforcement guarantee.
themeNote: The source site has exactly one theme. It has no dark theme, no shadows and no prefers-reduced-motion handling; do not generate dark variants.

sourceProject.description: Vite + React clone of coda.co, 15 routes
sourceProject.frameworkVersionsReadFrom: the source project's package.json, re-read when this repository was finalised (installed: react 18.3.1, vite 5.4.21)
sourceProject.styling: precompiled Tailwind-style stylesheet (public/styles/coda-main.css, minified on one line) served as-is; page JSX keeps the site's own class names
sourceProject.snapshotWarning: This repository is a snapshot of the source project at build time. If the source project changes (dependency bump, new route, copy or layout change), re-diff its counts, versions and citations before trusting this repository; extraction/verify_all.py re-checks citations only while the source tree sits beside this folder.

countsNote: Recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py (check [f]); a wrong number here fails the run.

scope.deliberateScopeReduction: Only these 15 routes exist. Every link to any other coda.co page (blog, careers, press, legal, guides, events, contact, security, about, portal, docs, jobs, social) is intentionally inert href="#". No templates or routes exist for them and none may be added.

copyEvidenceLevels.a-exact: Homepage copy is exact, from the user's own saved page.
copyEvidenceLevels.b-real-saved-copy: Five inner pages (coda-links, coda-giftcloud, distribution, consumer-platforms, pricing) carry real text from the user's own saved copies.
copyEvidenceLevels.c-original-slot-sized: Nine pages (codapay, coda-webstore, six industries, merchant-of-record) carry original AI-written copy sized to the original slot lengths, not Coda's wording.

scope.structureEvidence: Structure, layout and motion of the homepage were measured against live coda.co (about 1px) and documented in the source project's CLONE_SPEC.md. For the 14 inner pages the same claim is carried over from earlier build-agent reports and is not independently recorded in a project file.

constraints.noExternalRequests: All images, fonts and video are local. Generated pages must not reference remote URLs.
constraints.realCompany: The source is a real, live, commercial company: real third-party logos, real payment-brand marks, real product UI screenshots, a real-people hero video and real partner names appear. Generators must never reproduce, redraw, approximate or fabricate them (see assets/asset-roles.json generationPolicy).
constraints.licensing: Do not publish or make this repository public without the owner's licence review. ABC Monument Grotesk is a commercial licensed typeface and is not redistributable; this repository documents where it is used and grants no rights to it.
constraints.noDarkThemeNoShadowsNoReducedMotion: The source has no dark theme, no box-shadows and no prefers-reduced-motion handling; reducedMotionFallback in section contracts is a design rule, not mirrored behaviour.
constraints.noPerInstanceTokenOverride: PageSpecs have no per-instance token/style override field; styling belongs to the contracts.
